notes.title: Centauri Dark Price Cut!
notes.content:
Hi Pilots!

Just dropping in to inform you that Centauri Dark's price has been slashed - going forward it's now available for just $4.99 USD!

Updates have been much slower than usual due to life obligations, so I figured I'd make it more accessible so it's even easier to hop in the pilot's chair.

Good luck!
- Devon

notes.title: Content Update: New CORE and Gauntlet Levels!
notes.content:
Hello Pilots,

A new content update is hear. Here's what it contains:
- 3 new CORE levels to test your combat skills
- 2 new Gauntlet levels to test your reflexes and finesse
- Updates to the Credits menu
- Minor bugfixes and optimizations

Don't die!
- Devon

notes.title: Day One Optimization Hotfix + Demo Improvements
notes.content:
Hey Pilots! Just pushed out a few little quick performance updates to the game:

- Updated the whole Centauri Dark Demo to be more analogous to the current state of the main game
- Render distance optimizations
- light culling to reduce drawcalls caused by enemy lights on the environment
- dynamic batching optimizations to reduce GPU material render load

Happy fighting!
-Devon

notes.title: CENTAURI DARK IS NOW AVAILABLE
notes.content:
Hey Pilots!

It was a long road getting here but the day has finally come - Centauri Dark is now available for purchase!

However, I'm by no means done - I'll be supporting the game by rolling out additional content including new CORE scenarios, Gauntlet scenarios, as well as subweapons in the coming months. If you enjoy the game please pick the game up, share it with your friends, and leave it a review. It all helps a lot! :)

Good luck in battle!
Devon
